note: Public list prices on the date recorded. Every cost on the results site is priced from these rates and the token counts each cell's own logs carry; a seat with no rate here is unpriced and keeps cost_is_complete false. Update the date whenever a rate changes.

sources.anthropic: priced by the Claude CLI's own envelope (total_cost_usd), which applies Anthropic list prices per model

glm-5.3-flash.note: Regular list price. A launch promotion (0.075 / 0.015 / 0.25) ran through 2026-09-09; the list rate is used so runs before and after it price the same.

claude.note: The Claude CLI returns total_cost_usd per dispatch at list price; that figure is used directly and no rate is duplicated here.

codex_total_only.note: Codex 0.144.x prints one figure, 'tokens used', with no input/output split. Cells run before the driver captured --json events are priced with the split below and flagged cost_precision=estimated; the low and high bounds price the whole total at the cached-input and output rates. Cells with a captured split are priced exactly.
